faq.a: Ekrem is associated with the Arabic form أَكْرَم, whose core sense is ekrem; most generous (turkish form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Ekrem?
faq.a: Ekrem is associated with Arabic. Ekrem is the Turkish form of Arabic أَكْرَم (Akram), the elative of كَرِيم, meaning 'most generous'.
Yes — the underlying form أَكْرَم is Arabic.
Ekrem can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Ekrem should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root ك ر م is Quranic, but Akram is not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Ekrem mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Ekrem is rendered اکرم and carries the sense اکرم، سب سے زیادہ سخی.

faq.q: What does Ekrem mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Ekrem is rendered اکرم and carries the sense اکرم، بخشنده‌ترین.
A romanized syllable approximation is ek-rem. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Ekrem?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Ekrem, ekrem. Script forms are أَكْرَم, اکرم, अकरम.

faq.q: Is Ekrem a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
